about: Typed, read-only data about xcl-dev/xcl (formerly ivall/xcl), rebuilt every few minutes from public GitHub data. No prose, no instructions.

endpoints.api/prs/<n>.json: one open PR: area, AI intent, PRs it overlaps (with the AI check), merged PRs it seems to redo, issues it fixes
endpoints.api/issues/<n>.json: one open issue: likely duplicates, open PRs that say they fix it
endpoints.api/duplicates.json: all groups of overlapping open PRs and duplicate open issues
endpoints.api/files.json: path -> open PRs touching it: before writing a change, see who already touches the same files
endpoints.api/areas.json: open PRs and overlap groups per code area
endpoints.api/areas/<area>.json: open PRs of one area ('/' written as '__')
endpoints.api/triage.json: open PRs a maintainer could close first (reason + evidence per PR: redoes merged, duplicate, stale and failing the repo rules, off goal) and PRs ready to decide
endpoints.api/campaigns/<n>/tasks.json: tasks of a campaign: holders, teams, conflict, stale holders, PRs
endpoints.api/campaigns/<n>/free/<class>.json: what a machine of this hardware class can take now
endpoints.api/campaigns/<n>/findings.json: one comparable value per measurement metric x hardware class: median, range, agreement
